brief: Push or replace a record with matched-pair snapshot and callback semantics.
decl: void record_transition(RecordMachine &machine, std::span<const std::byte> pairs, std::uint32_t identifier, std::uint32_t handler, std::uint32_t push, std::uint32_t parameter);
notes: Original instructions establish controller ordering; callback bodies remain external implementations.

bookkeeping.scope: Complete controller body on supplied valid byte images and scalar state. Callback bodies are explicitly substituted by controlled observation/mutation hooks.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Stable caller-owned record arena before the external scalar globals; valid mapped current records and returning cdecl callback bridges. Transition requires a valid nonnull entry current record; activation separately supports null current and null optional handlers. DF is clear for original word copies. Pair-table storage represents the separate original 0x88acdc image and must not alias the machine arena.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 96 controller cases exact under declared callback substitutions on MSVC and Zig/Clang; connected lifecycle traces also match. See docs/recovery/record-transitions.md.
bookkeeping.callback_substitutions: Eight original callback entrypoints are replaced by RET plus explicit scripted observation/mutation hooks. Full controller body, full arena and every callback-entry snapshot are compared; actual handlers remain external.
unresolved: Actual callback implementations and effects outside the observed arena/scalars.
Complete owner lifecycle and live game integration.
Original faults, stack overflow and unsupported address windows.
